      "observations": [
        "All four owned paths and the complete new 78-line test were read. The patch adds a readonly timerIsRunning attribute whose getter writes whether mTimer is non-null. StopTimer cancels and clears that pointer. This is an observable timer-handle probe, not direct proof of native callback execution.",
        "The discovery timer path now gets the owner before processing headers. If the owner is absent, it logs that fact without accessing a URI and leaves leftToProcess at zero, so it removes that queue head. The update path logs the folder URI only inside its owner guard and logs a missing-owner error otherwise. These are concrete guarded timer paths, not proof that every AutoSync log is safe.",
        "Changed logging uses MOZ_LOG_FMT and direct folder->URI().get() access instead of folderName temporaries which actually held URIs. The supplied owner nsCOMPtr retains a valid object within the guarded branch. Object existence is distinct from whether that object still belongs to the live folder tree.",
        "The new test discovers Drafts/Sent on a fake IMAP account, simulates startup and app-idle observer notifications, asserts a running timer/non-empty discovery and update queues, removes the account, waits for the timer handle to disappear and asserts both queues are empty. Its manifest entry explicitly sets MOZ_LOG=IMAPAutoSync:4. It does not measure stop latency or deliberately retain deleted folder objects.",
        "The fixed accepted source has a separate DiscardGoneFolders method, absent from the original Git blob. It removes missing owners or owners no longer registered for their URI and clears an in-progress update when its head was discarded. The later accepted test adds 20 mailboxes, keeps strong references after deletion, checks lookup eviction and adds a 2000 ms bound. Those behavior and test phases are separate from this owned logging patch and receive no additional history credit here.",
        "The original test assertion messages are non-empty and contain should. The pre-existing MOZ_ASSERT(autoSyncStateObj) in the changed callback has no explicit message. The later accepted strong-reference test ends with another message-less Assert.equal; that is a later comparison limit, not an assertion added by this original commit.",
        "The priority-queue completion log still accesses folder->URI() outside an explicit folder guard. The selected caller reaches this path for no-pending-message or zero-size results. Owner availability on every such path was not established, so this entry makes no blanket null-safety claim or reproduced failure claim. Broader queue/lifecycle and harness cleanup were not chased.",
        "The existing protocol-specific periodic-update lesson remains applicable to the exact accepted IMAP/non-IMAP dispatch branch; this patch does not introduce that protocol behavior. Optional AutoSync-state output-pointer and database-priority lessons concern different contracts and are not forced into this logging finding.",
        "The complete primary Bug2004614 description/comments 0–2 and actual footer were read. The author says logging with MOZ_LOG=IMAPAutoSync:4 hit null-pointer errors while investigating an autosync timer which never went away. The logging obstacle and the underlying timer-liveness investigation remain separate; this is a reported observation, not a reproduced result.",
        "The full own D275402 creation-to-final timeline and all four actual inline bodies were read, including the submitted code-only test-comment suggestion. There are no summary edits. Initial format-string and direct URI suggestions are explicitly optional future advice. The author then adopts them in the changed logs and asks for another review; actual source, not their NotDone labels, establishes adoption.",
        "The added test comment about simulating manager startup/app-idle appears in the owned fixture. The misleading folderName temporary held a URI and is removed. These accepted local comment/naming/logging outcomes do not establish a universal formatter, temporary-variable or logging rule.",
        "Ben approves the earlier version. Kai explicitly reviews only the added delta above that approval, so the record does not claim two independent full reviews. A later request says the last Try lacked the latest changes. The timeline ultimately records landing with ongoing or failed builds; linked jobs/docs are unopened and no new test was run.",
        "The original guarded logging/test phase stays distinct from the accepted DiscardGoneFolders behavior and retained-folder/deadline regression. Scoped timer guards and queue-empty assertions are source facts, while the remaining priority-path owner-lifetime gap and later assertion-message gap stay explicit."
